title: Failure of resilience for the parity-based function
statement: For a positive integer $m$, define a function on $\{\!-1,1\!\}^{3m}$ by taking the AND of the parities on the first $2m$ coordinates and on the last $2m$ coordinates. This function is not resilient of order $2m-1$, meaning that it does not both have all nonempty Fourier coefficients of degree at most $2m-1$ equal to zero and have mean zero.
